Author: Violet
Name: Violet Music Player
Punchline: Performs and plays the songs in [Violet] Music Solo Player: shuffle performing, background music and shared house music packs.
Description: Type /vmusic for the window. The first time, it creates [Violet] Music Solo Player in Penumbra for you (or you point it at the copy you have). Perform: picks songs from [Violet] Music Solo Player, selects them in Penumbra and performs the matching instrument emote (guitar, keyboard or violin). Background music: the plugin plays your songs itself, inside houses or everywhere, at its own volume. House music packs: a playlist for one house that everyone who has it hears in step. Organize page: rename song groups and songs, move songs between groups. /vmusic help lists the chat commands.
